summary_ja: この告示を平成26年3月31日から適用し、一部の改正規定は平成25年3月31日から適用する。
summary_en: Provides that this Public Notice applies from March 31, 2014, with certain amending provisions applying from March 31, 2013.
paragraphs: This Public Notice applies from March 31, 2014; provided, however, that the provisions amending Article 14, paragraph (1), item (ii), the provisions amending the heading of Article 42 and paragraph (1) of that Article, and the provisions amending Article 128, item (iii), Article 248-3, paragraph (1) and Article 248-4, paragraph (1) of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy Status of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of the Assets, etc. Held by Such Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. in Article 1, and the provisions adding one article to the Supplementary Provisions of the Public Notice Partially Amending the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy Status of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of the Assets, etc. Held by Such Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. in Article 2, apply from March 31, 2013.

sections_en.s05: Supplementary Provisions (FSA Public Notice No. 7 of March 8, 2013)
